FAIL.summary: The enterprise application needs at least {{minimumEnterpriseAdminOwners}} user owner(s) whose UPN starts with {{ownerUpnPrefix}}.
actions: In Entra admin center, open Enterprise applications and locate this application using its enterprise application Object ID.
Open Owners and add the responsible administrator account. Its UPN must start with {{ownerUpnPrefix}}.
Ensure at least {{minimumEnterpriseAdminOwners}} qualifying administrator owner(s) are listed, then run the report again. Registration owners are checked separately and may be different people.

UNKNOWN.summary: Owner details are incomplete. The report cannot confirm whether the enterprise application has enough administrator owners.
actions: Ask the report administrator to check owner collection and the reader application's Application.Read.All and User.Read.All consent.
Collect a new report with readable owner UPNs before adding or removing owners based on this result.
